credits.title: Sources & credits
credits.intro: Every 3D model, mapping, ontology term and number in this app comes from the sources below.
credits.texts: Explanatory texts are the project's own wording; facts are cited to OpenStax A&P 2e §19.1 and have not yet been expert-reviewed.
credits.terms: Turkish anatomical terms were translated during development and need expert review before public release.
credits.derivVo2: Oxygen uptake is cited from College Physics 2e §7.8 for a 76-kg male. It is converted to mL/kg/min and scaled linearly to the 70-kg reference body of the heart values (A&P 2e §19.4). The cited value is shown too. Linear per-kg scaling is an assumption.
credits.derivFick: O₂ taken from blood = oxygen uptake (70 kg) ÷ cardiac output (Fick principle). It is the derived value linking the heart and lung engines; a textbook citation for the formula is still to be added.
credits.derivFlow: The blood-flow distribution comes from the A&P 2e §20.4 table. Its totals differ from the engine's cardiac output, so each organ's share of the column is applied to the engine's cardiac output. Running uses the "maximal exercise" column (the closest one).
credits.derivPending: Breathing rate and tidal volume during running and walking await a verifiable source; no value is invented.

resp.title: Respiratory engine
resp.extractionNote: O₂ taken from blood = oxygen uptake (70 kg) ÷ cardiac output — derived (Fick principle). Oxygen uptake was scaled per kg from the 76-kg reference body to the 70-kg body of the heart values.
resp.breathing: Breath indicator: one breath every {{s}} s (schematic expansion, not to scale)
resp.notBreathing: No verified breathing rate for this scenario; the lungs are shown still.
resp.missingNote: No verifiable source yet for breathing rate and tidal volume during running; no value is invented.

exercise.title: Exercise across systems
exercise.flowNote: Each organ's share of the table column × the engine's cardiac output (derived). Running is based on the maximal exercise column of OpenStax A&P 2e §20.4.
exercise.compareNote: All values from the engine; ratios are derived. Muscle models come in Milestone 4.
